messages.author: a59c03f035656bc1
messages.subject: Use native BLAS for Renjin
parts:
Hi,

Since Renjin is using netlib-java API to easily link to local native BLAS or LAPACK library. After I have openblas library installed, I have 10x speedup on GNU-R but very little speedups on Renjin. I am wondering if there is anyone have done some benchmarking on Renjin with native BLAS. How can I check if Renjin is calling the right Blas library.

Thanks,

messages.author: f06db63329fab1f9
messages.subject: Re: Use native BLAS for Renjin
parts:
Hi Max,

If you're on a *nix system, you can run "lsof -p <pid>" when renjin is running to see if the JVM has loaded the native libraries. 

You can also turn on logging for "org.netlib.*" to see which versions gets loaded, or check LAPACK.getInstance().getClass().getName() to see which is in use.

Best,
Alex
